text: {"label":"Increasing Physical Activity in Adults","definition":"Research on measuring and increasing exercise and physical activity, and reducing sedentary behavior, mainly in adults, using self-monitoring, goal setting, feedback, contingency contracts, technology, and multicomponent health-behavior packages.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike the neighbouring topic on children's physical activity, this centers on adults and general health habits; it targets everyday exercise rather than athletic skill or broad behavioral intervention programs."}
